_doc: Per-texture-set overrides of the automatic R2c material choice (r2auto.py, Docs/remaster-pipeline.md §14). Keys = R1 texture set (original diffuse stem). 'auto': false = hand look (class materials 'metal'/'leather'/'cloth' + regions, as tuned for the R2c pilot); otherwise 'regions' apply on top of auto and 'replace' swaps an auto material. Region = [material or [[material, factor], ...], [u0, row0, u1, row1] (0..1 of the atlas, row 0 = top), class filter ('metal'|'leather'|'cloth'|null), optional filter {sat_max, sat_min, lum_max, lum_min, metal_min}]; 'skip': true = no CC0 and no plates for the set. Every entry says why.

G3_Human_Hero_Body_Diffuse_S1.why: R2c pilot (hand-tuned, approved): the tunic is smooth enough to class as leather but is wool; the dark trousers are hide (classed cloth); fur: the dark fringe along the tunic hem (batch)

G3_Human_Paladin_Body_Diffuse_S1.why: R2c pilot (hand-tuned, approved): plates inside mixed islands by R1 metal mask; knot-ornamented pauldrons are dark steel with a weak mask

G3_Human_RebMercenary_Body_Diffuse_S1.why: R2c pilot (hand-tuned, approved): 'cloth' here is dark hide except the blue-green shirt; two chainmail panels on the chest piece; fur: the round fur piece (batch)

G3_Human_Slave_Body_Diffuse_S1.why: iron shackles (grey with white highlights) at the bottom right are not classed metal on a set without specular map

G3_Human_Slave_Cloth_Diffuse_S1.why: rope belt painted into the trousers; iron shackles bottom middle

G3_Human_Smith_Body_Diffuse_S1.why: the smith's leather apron (top right) is classed cloth (brown, not narrow)

G3_Human_Peasant_Body_Diffuse_S1.why: rope belt strip at the top edge

G3_Human_NordmarBabe_Body_Diffuse_S1.why: fur collar, fur vest and fur trims; the red-brown pieces are suede leather (classed cloth)

G3_Human_NrdWarrior_Body_Diffuse_S1.why: Gorn's fur cloak (bottom left) and fur collar

G3_Human_NordmarElite_Body_Diffuse_S1.why: fur cape (bottom right), fur pieces and the fur around the face mask (the bright mask itself excluded)

G3_NordmarScout_Body_Diffuse_S1.why: grey fur cloak and brown fur piece

G3_Human_Nomad_Novice_Diffuse_S1.why: twisted rope/straw rings at the top

G3_Human_King_Body_Diffuse_S1.why: braided rope trims (rings, bottom left); the grey plates inside them excluded by saturation

G3_Human_Slave_Babe_Body_Diffuse_S1.why: the brown studded top and skirt are leather (babe sets default to cloth)

G3_Monster_Skeleton__Body_Diffuse_S1.why: bones (NrdAncient): no CC0 material and no plates; the original stays
